files.README.md:
# catalog-sync workspace

catalog-sync keeps the product catalogue aligned with vendor feed drops.

- Rollout records live in docs/deployments.md; they are stamped with the coordinator clock (UTC, trailing Z).
- Application lines in logs/catalog-sync.log carry the APAC collector offset (+08:00).
- CS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH marks a vendor value that the loader could not read as the field's declared type.
files.docs/catalog-schema.md:
# Catalogue field schema

| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| sku | string | vendor-stable identifier |
| price | number | minor units are not used |
| voltage | number | volts, no unit suffix |
| weight_kg | number | kilograms |
